# contract-tests-gen

> Generate readable pytest contract tests from an OpenAPI 3.x document, injection-safe, with a small schema validator, injectable transport and drift check Python package `trysac-contract-tests-gen`, import name `contract_tests_gen`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
